# Kata Agent Team

> An autonomous, continuously improving agent team organized as a daily
> Plan-Do-Study-Act cycle.
<!-- enum:published-skills:count -->
> Nineteen skills, plain JavaScript,
<!-- /enum -->
> zero infrastructure to maintain.

Kata is an open-source agent team for coding repositories. Eight agent
personas — Staff Engineer, Release Engineer, Security Engineer, DevEx
Engineer, Product Manager, Technical Writer, Archivist, and Improvement
Coach — operate the daily Plan-Do-Study-Act cycle.
<!-- enum:published-skills:count -->
The team's work is carried by nineteen skills.
<!-- /enum -->
The team runs on plain
JavaScript with no databases, no queues, and no third-party dependencies;
shared state lives as markdown in a Git repository.

Install via `apm install forwardimpact/kata-skills`, then ask Claude to set
up the team.

The documentation tree covers three jobs. Getting Started takes a repository
with no automation to one completed shift. Run a Continuously Improving Agent
Team covers the daily loop: the agent roster, the memory and coordination line,
the storyboard and coaching session, and the routing of every Study finding.
Take a Change from Spec to Shipped covers the spec, design, plan, implement,
review, merge, and release arc, together with the approval gates and the trust
boundary. Kata runs on the Gemba platform at https://www.gemba.team/, follows
the Jidoka instruction architecture at https://www.jidoka.team/, and adopts the
repository structure at https://www.monorepo.team/.
